rendered: The paper gives no cost per kWh for theNFA 811[1]pouch cell. Its only NFA pouch cell data are formation and C/3 cycling curves (Fig. 7[2]), with no cost figure. The only cost-per-kWh value in the paper is the DOE cell cost target of$80/kWh[3], which is a target rather than a cost for that cell. The paper says only thatcurrent manufacturing costs are about double this figure[4], without giving a figure for any specific cell.
